The problem

Getting paid shouldn't be complicated.

Asking for money should be the easy part. PayLink turns it into one simple, shareable link.

  • Too many steps

    Customers abandon complicated payment processes.

  • Scattered payment requests

    Payment instructions get lost across chats, emails, and invoices.

  • Unnecessary friction

    Businesses need a straightforward way to request and collect payments.

How it works

From request to payment in three steps.

01

Create

Prepare a payment link for a product, service, or specific amount.

02

Share

Send the link through the communication channels your customers already use.

03

Collect

Let customers open the payment page and follow the available payment instructions.
